title: IAMMAI First-Pass Lineage Record
description: First-pass schema for one additive lineage move only. This object is small, explicit, anti-erasure, and anti-mush. It records one from/to lineage relation together with what remained and what changed, without becoming a full continuity ontology, storage model, or final relation vocabulary.

lineage_record_id.description: Bounded identifier for this one lineage record object. It makes the lineage move referable without implying a final global identity system or sovereign record status.

recorded_at.description: Recorded-at value for when this lineage move was explicitly housed as an object. This remains a conservative non-empty string rather than a frozen final timestamp model.

from_ref.description: Bounded earlier reference from which the lineage move is being read. It preserves that later does not erase earlier.

to_ref.description: Bounded later reference to which the lineage move is being read. It names the later surface without implying silent supersession or total authority absorption.

relation_type.description: Bounded type of lineage move claimed between from_ref and to_ref. The field is required, but the vocabulary remains intentionally open and revisable in first-pass form.

preserves.description: Explicit bounded statements of what remained across this lineage move. This is central to lineage and is not optional narrative decoration.

changes.description: Explicit bounded statements of what changed across this lineage move. This is central to lineage and is not optional narrative decoration.
